content:
Hi all!

I add instances to show that the p-adic algebraic closure (i.e., the algebraic closure of p-adic rational numbers) and the field of p-adic complex numbers (i.e., the p-adic completion of the p-adic algebraic closure) are densely normed fields and are separable spaces (i.e., they admit a countable dense subset).

As a byproduct, the non-triviality of the norm on these fields can be proved by inferInstance. On the other hand, an instance is added to show that the completion of a densely normed field is again a densely normed field.

This is my first PR to mathlib4. Please let me know if any improvements can be made.

PR: https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/41957

Note: These results are some byproducts of my project on formalization of non-archimedean functional analysis (https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.21734). I believe they, especially DenselyNormedField for the p-adic complex number, will be helpful for p-adic analysis and p-adic geometry.
